comparator.name: South and Southeast Asian Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: The current catalogue confirms the 60 EC first year and now lists Philosophy of Science in English. The required second-year Reading module retains a prerequisite for the former Area Studies core, which is absent from the revised first-year groups. The adopted regulations no longer list this prerequisite separately but direct readers to the prospectus for progression. The full 180 EC catalogue route remains unverified until the applicable requirement is clarified.

programmes.label: South and Southeast Asian Studies at Leiden University

exception.reason: The revised first year is verified. The required Reading module still lists a prerequisite absent from the revised first-year curriculum. The applicable requirement for this cohort needs confirmation.
exception.curriculumContext: Leiden combines regional history, culture, religion and political economy with a sustained language sequence and later regional research.

audience.programmeDescription: Leiden’s degree studies South and Southeast Asia, with particular attention to India, Tibet and Indonesia. Students study regional history, religion, culture and politics alongside Hindi, Indonesian, Sanskrit or Tibetan.
